appcaches.name: App caches & logs
appcaches.running: {{.App}} is running and uses this cache. Quit {{.App}} first.
appcaches.caches.title: App caches
appcaches.caches.what: Files that apps keep to work faster: downloaded pages and images, compiled shaders, temporary data. Apple's system caches are not listed.
appcaches.caches.why: An app recreates its cache when needed. Caches of running apps can't be selected.
appcaches.caches.after: The first start of the app and the first pages it opens are a bit slower.
appcaches.updates.title: Update leftovers
appcaches.updates.what: Downloaded updates that apps (Cursor, VS Code and other Electron apps) keep after installing them.
appcaches.updates.why: The update is already installed; these copies are not used anymore.
appcaches.updates.after: Nothing changes. The next update is downloaded again as usual.
appcaches.logs.title: Logs
appcaches.logs.what: Logs and crash reports that apps write to ~/Library/Logs.
appcaches.logs.why: They are only needed to investigate a problem that is happening right now.
appcaches.logs.after: Old logs are gone; apps start writing new ones.
